mapper.select: select ifd.* from inv_finance_detail ifd, inv_finance_purchase ifp where ifd.data_class in ('NEW_PURCHASE','ADD_PURCHASE') and ifd.document_id=ifp.finance_purchase_id

select ifp.is_limited, fc.currency_name as currency_desc, ifp.annual_rate, cba.bank_account_num, cba.bank_account_name, cb.bank_name, cba.bank_account_id, cba.bank_id, ifd.* from inv_finance_detail ifd, inv_finance_purchase ifp, fnd_currency fc, csh_bank cb, csh_bank_account cba where ifd.approved_status='APPROVED' AND ifd.data_class in ('NEW_PURCHASE','ADD_PURCHASE') and ifd.document_id=ifp.finance_purchase_id and fc.currency_code=ifp.currency and cba.bank_account_id=ifp.bank_account_id and cb.bank_id=cba.bank_id and (ifp.finance_purchase_id=#{documentId} or ifp.parent_purchase_id=#{documentId})

select ifd.inv_finance_detail_id, ifd.financial_date, ifd.data_class, ifd.financial_amount, inp.financial_products_name, inp.financial_products_num, inp.financial_max_amount, ifp.is_limited, ifp.financial_type, ifp.financial_category, ifd.start_date, ifd.end_date, ifp.annual_rate from inv_finance_purchase ifp, inv_finance_detail ifd, inv_financial_products inp where ifp.bank_account_id=#{bankAccountId} and ifp.finance_products_id=inp.inv_products_id and ifd.document_id=ifp.finance_purchase_id and ifd.approved_status='APPROVED' and ifd.data_class in ('NEW_PURCHASE','ADD_PURCHASE') union select ifd.inv_finance_detail_id, ifd.financial_date, 'REDEEM' as data_class, ifd.financial_amount, inp.financial_products_name, inp.financial_products_num, inp.financial_max_amount, ifp.is_limited, ifp.financial_type, ifp.financial_category, ifd.start_date, ifd.end_date, ifp.annual_rate from inv_finance_purchase ifp, inv_finance_redeem ifr, inv_finance_detail ifd, inv_finance_detail ifdd, inv_financial_products inp where ifp.bank_account_id=#{bankAccountId} and ifp.finance_products_id=inp.inv_products_id and ifr.purchase_id=ifdd.inv_finance_detail_id and ifd.document_id=ifr.finance_redeem_id and ifdd.data_class in ('NEW_PURCHASE','ADD_PURCHASE') and ifdd.document_id=ifp.finance_purchase_id and ifdd.approved_status='APPROVED' and ifd.approved_status='APPROVED'
